findings.title: Campaigns still learning
findings.detail: Status shows learning for: PMax | Water Heater Leads. Read their numbers as early.
findings.surface: No change yet: judge them after the learning window
findings.label: Official
findings.rule: Run a new campaign at least 6 weeks, and allow 1 to 2 weeks or one full conversion cycle after a significant change.

findings.title: Products with cost and no conversions
findings.detail: 6 products had cost and no conversions, costing 1,455.00, 18.7% of the products report's cost. 5 of them spent at least 84.51, enough to judge on spend alone, costing 1,410.00. The largest share sits in product type Drain Tools, 96.9% of the products report's cost with no conversions. 5 of those that spent enough to judge are priced above their benchmark, carrying 1,410.00.
findings.surface: Price, listing groups, or the product data in Merchant Center
findings.label: Practitioner rule
findings.rule: When the problem is product or feed led, act on the feed or listing groups before changing bids. Check price first where a product is above its benchmark.

findings.title: Non brand searches with cost and no conversions
findings.detail: 11 non brand searches had cost and no conversions, costing 1,155.00, 21.5% of the listed Performance Max search cost. 5 of them spent at least 95.32, enough to judge on spend alone, costing 820.00. The other 6 cost 335.00. Every one needs a relevance call before a negative is added.
findings.label: Official
findings.rule: Performance Max negative keywords apply to Search and Shopping inventory only, up to 10,000 per campaign, and do not match close variants.

findings.title: Asset groups that spent enough to judge with no conversions
findings.surface: Assets, listing groups and final URL of those asset groups
findings.label: Practitioner rule
findings.rule: Check the asset group's products, assets and landing page before pausing it.

findings.title: Asset groups rated below Good carry spend
findings.detail: 2 asset groups rated Average or Poor carry 5,000.00, 34.8% of the asset group report's cost: Water Heaters | General (campaign still learning), Poor, 2,900.00; Drain Tools, Average, 2,100.00.
findings.label: Official
findings.rule: Google recommends Ad strength of Good or Excellent. Ad strength measures asset coverage and variety. It is not an auction input.

findings.title: Products priced above benchmark
findings.detail: 11 products are priced above their benchmark, carrying 4,320.00, 55.6% of the cost on products with a benchmark. Conv. rate is 1.10% above benchmark and 2.83% at or below it. 5 of them spent with no conversions, costing 1,410.00.

findings.label: Practitioner rule
findings.rule: Separate price pressure from ad rank or creative pressure before acting. A benchmark needs a valid GTIN.

findings.title: Products below the target ROAS
findings.detail: 12 products spent at least 84.51 with a ROAS below the target of 400%, costing 3,020.00.

findings.label: Practitioner rule
findings.rule: Use custom labels for business slicing and bidding logic. They do not raise rank by themselves.

findings.title: Google Display Network returns less conv. value per cost than PMax | Plumbing Supplies as a whole
findings.detail: In PMax | Plumbing Supplies, Google Display Network has 22.2% of the cost and 5.6% of the conv. value in the channel report. Its conv. value / cost is 0.95 against 3.79.
findings.surface: The channel report's diagnostics and the assets that channel uses
findings.label: Official
findings.rule: Performance Max optimises for marginal return across channels, so an average by channel can mislead. Judge the campaign against its goal. Do not cut a channel on this alone.

findings.title: Google Display Network costs more per conversion than PMax | Water Heater Leads as a whole (campaign still learning)
findings.detail: In PMax | Water Heater Leads, Google Display Network has 27.1% of the cost and 10.7% of the conversions in the channel report. Its cost / conv. is 433.33 against 171.43.
findings.surface: The channel report's diagnostics and the assets that channel uses
findings.label: Official
findings.rule: Performance Max optimises for marginal return across channels, so an average by channel can mislead. Judge the campaign against its goal. Do not cut a channel on this alone.

findings.title: Brand searches inside Performance Max
findings.detail: Brand searches are 16.4% of the listed Performance Max search cost, 48.4% of the listed conversions and 35.9% of the listed conv. value in the search terms report. Search campaigns that also carry the brand: Brand (its keywords include "northside plumbing" (Phrase match)).
findings.surface: Brand exclusions in the campaign settings, or exact match brand keywords in Search
findings.label: Official
findings.rule: Brand exclusions block brand terms on Search and Shopping, and Google prefers them over negatives for brand protection. Practitioner rule: brand traffic is not waste without business context. Official (references/pmax.md): only a Search keyword in exact match identical to the search is preferred over Performance Max. Identical phrase or broad keywords share the next priority with identical search themes, and a budget limited Search campaign lets Performance Max serve on exact terms at times.

findings.detail: In PMax | Plumbing Supplies, Search partners has 3.2% of the cost and 2.5% of the conv. value in the channel report. Its conv. value / cost is 3.00 against 3.79.
findings.surface: The channel report's diagnostics and the assets that channel uses
findings.label: Official
findings.rule: Performance Max optimises for marginal return across channels, so an average by channel can mislead. Judge the campaign against its goal. Do not cut a channel on this alone.

findings.title: Words in searches that never converted
findings.detail: In two or more searches with cost and no conversions: "jobs" (265.00), "diy" (195.00). Candidates only: a word can be relevant to the business. Held back because every word appears in a product title, asset group name or campaign name: "drain", "snake".
findings.label: Practitioner rule
findings.rule: Check every search that holds the word before excluding it.
